payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in abstractive summarization.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, outperforming Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores on both CNN/DailyMail and New York Times datasets compared to the other tasks.
The combination of all three tasks (SR, NSG, MDG) does not outperform the SR task alone when sufficient data is available.
